evals.prompt: Render this .mmd flowchart to SVG with the tokyo-night theme.
evals.expected_output: Renders the .mmd file to an SVG using the tokyo-night theme.

evals.prompt: Create a sequence diagram for this API call flow and render it as ASCII.
evals.expected_output: Picks sequence as the diagram type and renders ASCII output for the terminal.

evals.prompt: Batch render every .mmd file in ./diagrams/ to SVG.
evals.expected_output: Renders the directory of .mmd files in parallel (default 4 workers) to SVG.
expectations: Runs batch render with 4 parallel workers

evals.prompt: Beautify this flowchart with the dracula theme.
evals.expected_output: Re-renders the flowchart applying the dracula vibrant theme.

evals.prompt: Render a state diagram for this order lifecycle as SVG for the docs.
evals.expected_output: Picks state diagram type and renders SVG with a light/docs-friendly theme.
expectations: Picks an appropriate light theme (e.g. github-light)

evals.prompt: Render an ER diagram for this database schema.
evals.expected_output: Picks ER as the diagram type and renders the schema.

evals.prompt: I want a terminal-friendly diagram of this workflow.
evals.expected_output: Renders the workflow as an ASCII diagram.
expectations: Picks flowchart diagram type for the workflow

evals.prompt: Apply the catppuccin-mocha theme to my .mmd file.
evals.expected_output: Re-renders the .mmd file with the catppuccin-mocha theme.

evals.prompt: beautiful-mermaid isn't installed — what do I do?
evals.expected_output: Tells the user to run npm install in the skill directory, then retry.
expectations: Instructs user to run npm install in the skill directory

evals.prompt: Render this .mmd file but the syntax seems invalid.
evals.expected_output: Suggests testing on mermaid.live first and cites the DIAGRAM_TYPES reference for common errors.
expectations: Cites references/DIAGRAM_TYPES.md for common syntax errors
